+import base64
+import json
+import os
+import secrets
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+@dataclass
+class EnvelopeEncryptionResult:
+    wrapped_data_key: str
+    nonce: str
+    ciphertext: str
+    key_id: str
+    provider: str = "google-cloud-kms"
+
+    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        return {
+            "provider": self.provider,
+            "key_id": self.key_id,
+            "wrapped_data_key": self.wrapped_data_key,
+            "nonce": self.nonce,
+            "ciphertext": self.ciphertext,
+        }
+
+
+class GoogleCloudKMSClient:
+    def __init__(self, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
+        self.api_key = api_key or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_KMS_API_KEY")
+        self.base_url = "https://cloudkms.googleapis.com/v1"
+        if not self.api_key:
+            raise ValueError("GOOGLE_CLOUD_KMS_API_KEY is required")
+
+    def encrypt(self, key_name: str, plaintext: bytes) -> bytes:
+        url = f"{self.base_url}/{key_name}:encrypt"
+        headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
+        body = {"plaintext": base64.b64encode(plaintext).decode("ascii")}
+        response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=json.dumps(body), timeout=30)
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        data = response.json()
+        return base64.b64decode(data["ciphertext"])
+
+
+def _xor_stream(key: bytes, nonce: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:
+    from hashlib import sha256
+
+    out = bytearray()
+    counter = 0
+    while len(out) < len(data):
+        block = sha256(key + nonce + counter.to_bytes(8, "big")).digest()
+        out.extend(block)
+        counter += 1
+    return bytes(a ^ b for a, b in zip(data, out))
+
+
+def envelope_encrypt(plaintext: bytes, key_name: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> EnvelopeEncryptionResult:
+    kms = GoogleCloudKMSClient(api_key=api_key)
+    data_key = secrets.token_bytes(32)
+    wrapped_data_key = kms.encrypt(key_name, data_key)
+    nonce = secrets.token_bytes(12)
+    ciphertext = _xor_stream(data_key, nonce, plaintext)
+    return EnvelopeEncryptionResult(
+        wrapped_data_key=base64.b64encode(wrapped_data_key).decode("ascii"),
+        nonce=base64.b64encode(nonce).decode("ascii"),
+        ciphertext=base64.b64encode(ciphertext).decode("ascii"),
+        key_id=key_name,
+    )
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    import sys
+
+    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
+        raise SystemExit("usage: envelope_encrypt.py <key_name> <plaintext>")
+    result = envelope_encrypt(sys.argv[2].encode("utf-8"), sys.argv[1])
+    print(json.dumps(result.to_dict()))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import boto3
+
+
+def _decode_ciphertext(ciphertext: str) -> bytes:
+    try:
+        return base64.b64decode(ciphertext, validate=True)
+    except Exception:
+        return ciphertext.encode("utf-8")
+
+
+def decrypt_payload(ciphertext: str, key_id: Optional[str] = None, encryption_context: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None, region_name: Optional[str] = None) -> bytes:
+    kms = boto3.client("kms", region_name=region_name or os.getenv("AWS_REGION") or os.getenv("AWS_DEFAULT_REGION"))
+    kwargs: Dict[str, Any] = {"CiphertextBlob": _decode_ciphertext(ciphertext)}
+    if key_id:
+        kwargs["KeyId"] = key_id
+    if encryption_context:
+        kwargs["EncryptionContext"] = encryption_context
+    response = kms.decrypt(**kwargs)
+    return response["Plaintext"]
+
+
+def decrypt_payload_text(ciphertext: str, key_id: Optional[str] = None, encryption_context: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None, region_name: Optional[str] = None, encoding: str = "utf-8") -> str:
+    return decrypt_payload(ciphertext, key_id=key_id, encryption_context=encryption_context, region_name=region_name).decode(encoding)
+
+
+def _main() -> None:
+    import argparse
+
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Decrypt a ciphertext payload with AWS KMS.")
+    parser.add_argument("ciphertext", help="Base64 ciphertext blob or raw ciphertext string")
+    parser.add_argument("--key-id", dest="key_id")
+    parser.add_argument("--region", dest="region_name")
+    parser.add_argument("--encryption-context", dest="encryption_context", help='JSON object, e.g. {"purpose":"review"}')
+    parser.add_argument("--encoding", default="utf-8")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    encryption_context = json.loads(args.encryption_context) if args.encryption_context else None
+    print(decrypt_payload_text(args.ciphertext, key_id=args.key_id, encryption_context=encryption_context, region_name=args.region_name, encoding=args.encoding))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    _main()
*** End Patch
